svg.text: Proposal only; current source bounding boxes and reserved regions. No contact, mount or length acceptance.
Gray: retained source boxes | Blue: moved Pi36 | Dashed red: proposed support | Purple: R6 access
Magenta: H1 west | Teal: H11/H6 east pair | Orange: separate Pi-PWM2 return
N01 = 0/10. Bounding-box overlap selects queries; it does not prove collision. Source: owner C1 HTML.
